newsitem.title: UK: Standard gains as H1 matches expectations.
newsitem.headline: Standard gains as H1 matches expectations.

text.p: Standard Chartered Plc rose after releasing first-half results on Wednesday amid a stronger overall market.
"Standard usually goes up after figures. You get a good dividend increase with Standard and they haven't disappointed this time," said one analyst.

The banking group said its dividend would rise to 5.25p per share from 4.25p and that pre-tax profit was 435 million stg against 448 million last time, compared with forecasts of about 420 million to about 440 million.
"There's nothing abnormal in the figures and they are very much in line both divisionally and for individual items of the P&L (profit and loss breakdown)," said another analyst.
